test_analysis.what_it_asserts: a declared input that is absent produces BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT, with its exit code and the path named in the 'inputs:declared_inputs_present' detail
test_analysis.why_it_failed_after_the_anchor_repair: the gate evaluates integrity before blockage (`decide_status`: integrity -> BLOCKED -> reproduction). With the ledger no longer matching the pin the explorer published, that pre-existing integrity failure takes precedence, so the run reports INTEGRITY_FAILURE and the test's own scenario never gets to be the verdict
test_analysis.obligation_preserved: a real integrity inconsistency must still surface as a blocker of certification: the measured result after recertification is that the same test passes unchanged, because the integrity failure was repaired rather than masked
test_analysis.correct_resolution: recertify (restore the pins) — not relax the test, not reorder the precedence, and not assert 'blocked or integrity' which would accept an unidentifiable failure as a pass
